title: The Steklov spectrum of convex polygonal domains II: investigating spectral determination
summary: The extent to which the geometry of an object is determined by some associated spectral data is a longstanding problem. We investigate this problem in the context of the Steklov spectrum, focusing on convex polygons. We prove that almost all triangles are uniquely determined by their Steklov spectra within the class of all triangles; further results depending on the types of angles in the triangles are given.
